name: Roman Chair Sit-Up
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a roman chair and cross your arms at your chest.
Lower your torso back until roughly parallel to the floor — only as far as you control.
Sit up by contracting the abs; avoid yanking with the hip flexors.
Keep it controlled; add load only when bodyweight is easy.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate a machine core exercise for the abs. Roman Chair Sit-Up builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
